description: Add GUIDED / COLLABORATIVE LYRIC-WRITING MODE to the songwriter agent and wire the PLAN->WRITE seam. This is a new INTERACTION MODE over the EXISTING songwriter + critic — NOT new craft logic. The assistant steps through each lyric SECTION in Nashville order and for each: proposes a draft, self-flags concerns using the critic's FULL 12-category rubric (surfacing the section-relevant subset first), then waits for the user to react/confirm before the next section. Also wires the seam so the songwriter CONSUMES an existing Song Brief (from FEAT-001) instead of re-planning. Depends on FEAT-001 (brief spec/location conventions).
steps: In .kiro/agents/songwriter.md, add the include #[[file:core/methodology/critique.md]] to the Methodology/Reference section so the per-section critic checks load from the single source. Do NOT restate the 12 categories in the agent.

In .kiro/agents/songwriter.md, add a new '### GUIDED / COLLABORATIVE MODE' subsection alongside the existing INTERACTIVE MODE and AUTO-PILOT MODE. Trigger phrases: 'write with me', 'guide me', 'step through the lyrics', 'section by section', 'help me write it'. Describe the loop: walk sections in Nashville order (Chorus first -> Pre-Chorus -> Verse 1 -> Verse 2 -> Bridge/the Turn -> Final Chorus variation -> Intro/Outro), and for EACH section: (1) propose a draft, (2) SELF-FLAG concerns by applying the critic's FULL 12-category rubric from core/methodology/critique.md — surface the SECTION-RELEVANT subset first at each step while keeping the full checks available, (3) WAIT for the user to react/confirm before moving to the next section. State explicitly that these are the CRITIC'S checks applied per-section in real time (reference core/methodology/critique.md categories 1-12 by name/number; do NOT redefine them). Include the section-relevant emphasis mapping: Chorus -> Hook(1)+Prosody(3)+Singability(7)+Originality(6); Pre-Chorus -> Arc(4)/Structure(5) build/tension; Verse 1 -> Lyrics/imagery(2)+Prosody(3); Verse 2 -> Arc(4) 'adds new info'; Bridge -> Arc(4) 'the turn'; Final Chorus -> Arc(4) meaning shift + Emotional Intelligence(12). Note the 5 advanced assessments A1-A5 remain available for full critique. Note that critic and suno-optimizer agents stay AS-IS — the guided writer just front-loads the critic's checks.

In .kiro/agents/songwriter.md, add a SONG BRIEF CONSUMPTION seam: an 'If a Song Brief exists, use it as the plan' path stating that when a SONGNAME.brief.md exists (per SOP 09 / core/methodology/song-planning.md convention from FEAT-001), the songwriter uses it as the analysis/plan instead of re-running Phase 1 planning; if no brief exists it plans inline as today (or points to the song-planner). Reference the planning source rather than duplicating it.

In core/methodology/songwriting.md, add a SHORT interaction note (not new craft logic) stating that Nashville-order writing (Phase 2) may be delivered in a guided/collaborative mode where each section is proposed, self-critiqued against core/methodology/critique.md's checks, and confirmed by the user before proceeding. Frame it explicitly as an interaction-mode note, and cross-reference SOP 09 / song-planning.md for the planning half of the shared Collaborative/Guided Mode concept.

Update .kiro/sops/01-writing-a-song.md so 'PHASE 1: Analysis' points to SOP 09 / core/methodology/song-planning.md as the now-authoritative planning source (note Phase 1 can be done inline OR via the planner, and that an existing SONG BRIEF can be consumed directly). Add the guided section-by-section walkthrough as a documented OPTION in the writing phase (Phase 2), referencing the songwriter agent's GUIDED/COLLABORATIVE MODE and critique.md's per-section checks. Keep SOP numbering coherent (extend SOP 01 in place; do not renumber existing SOPs).

Ensure the shared framing is explicit in both the planner (FEAT-001) and writer touchpoints: one 'Collaborative / Guided Mode' concept = the same loop 'suggest a methodology-backed default -> surface concerns -> user confirms/overrides -> next step', applied to brief-decisions (planner) and to sections (writer). Add a one-line cross-reference in songwriter.md's GUIDED mode pointing to song-planner/SOP 09 as the planning-side counterpart.
acceptance_criteria: .kiro/agents/songwriter.md includes #[[file:core/methodology/critique.md]] and has a GUIDED / COLLABORATIVE MODE section with the five trigger phrases, the Nashville-order section loop (propose -> self-flag via critic's 12 categories -> wait for confirm), and the section-relevant emphasis mapping — all REFERENCING critique.md's 12 categories by name/number without redefining them.
.kiro/agents/songwriter.md has a documented 'consume an existing Song Brief' seam that uses SONGNAME.brief.md as the plan when present.
core/methodology/songwriting.md contains a short guided/collaborative interaction note in/around Phase 2 that references critique.md and does not add new craft rules.
.kiro/sops/01-writing-a-song.md PHASE 1 points to SOP 09 / song-planning.md as authoritative and documents the guided section-walkthrough option in the writing phase.

No craft rule (12 categories, prosody thresholds, hook timing) is duplicated in songwriter.md — grep confirms the guided section references critique.md categories rather than restating their definitions.
verification: Read the GUIDED / COLLABORATIVE MODE section and confirm it references the 12 categories from critique.md (by number/name) rather than redefining scoring scales or thresholds.
grep .kiro/sops/01-writing-a-song.md for pointers to SOP 09 / core/methodology/song-planning.md in PHASE 1.
Read the songwriting.md guided note and confirm it is framed as an interaction note referencing critique.md, not new craft logic.
findings: Added GUIDED / COLLABORATIVE MODE as a third interaction mode in .kiro/agents/songwriter.md alongside the existing INTERACTIVE and AUTO-PILOT modes (renamed the umbrella from 'Two Modes' to 'Three Modes of Operation').
